groups.sentence: Universities benchmark and review the AI policies and practices of peer institutions when developing their own.
Campus-wide discussions, summits, and stakeholder forums on AI build shared understanding.
Universities consult employers, alumni, and advisory boards and track workforce needs to keep AI guidance current.
Universities build or join a coalition of peer institutions to help set shared standards for AI.
Universities forge partnerships with industry, government agencies, and academic institutions to share knowledge and support AI work.
Universities engage students, faculty, staff, and the broader community in discussions and forums on AI.
Faculty and staff take part in university-wide conversations on AI and share effective practices and concerns.
